notes.content: LIBERAL STUDIES, B.A. INTEGRATED TEACHER EDUCATION PROGRAM (ITEP) EMPHASIS

1. Access the University Catalog for Programs and Degrees, General Education Requirements, and Graduation Requirements at CSUCI. 2. Access the Program Website and Program Information in the University Catalog. 3. Access Freshman 4-year Academic Roadmap. 4. Access the Admissions website for CSUCI admission requirements. 5. Access the Transfer Credit website for information about Associate Degrees for Transfer, and transfer credit resources for external exams and U.S. Military service. 6. Learn more About CSUCI . Articulation agreements are subject to change from one academic year to the next. It is recommended to review the applicable department agreement(s) in addition to the major agreement and that students meet with a counselor/academic advisor early and often during their academic career.
notes.contentHtml:
1. Access the University Catalog for Programs and Degrees, General Education Requirements, and Graduation Requirements at CSUCI.

2. Access the Program Website and Program Information in the University Catalog.

3. Access Freshman 4-year Academic Roadmap.

4. Access the Admissions website for CSUCI admission requirements.

5. Access the Transfer Credit website for information about Associate Degrees for Transfer, and transfer credit resources for external exams and U.S. Military service.

6. Learn more About CSUCI.

Articulation agreements are subject to change from one academic year to the next. It is recommended to review the applicable department agreement(s) in addition to the major agreement and that students meet with a counselor/academic advisor early and often during their academic career.

notes.content: 1. Requirements for Admission to the Integrated Teacher Education Program (ITEP) Emphasis: Students must be accepted into the Teaching Credential program prior to enrolling in the 400-level EDAP courses. Students may apply for admission in the first semester of their junior year after completing 60 units. Please visit the School of Education website for more information about applying to the credential program part of the degree. 2. GPA Requirement: A minimum GPA of 3.0 "B" are required to remain in this Emphasis.
notes.contentHtml:
1. Requirements for Admission to the Integrated Teacher Education Program (ITEP) Emphasis:

  1. Students must be accepted into the Teaching Credential program prior to enrolling in the 400-level EDAP courses. Students may apply for admission in the first semester of their junior year after completing 60 units. Please visit the School of Education website for more information about applying to the credential program part of the degree.

2. GPA Requirement: A minimum GPA of 3.0 "B" are required to remain in this Emphasis.
